metrics.name: overall_accuracy
metrics.description: Proportion of correct responses across all coherence levels (timed_out trials excluded). Roitman & Shadlen 2002 monkey psychometric averages around 0.80 across this coherence range; Pinet et al. 2024 jsPsych validation reports 0.79 for adult human subjects.

metrics.name: accuracy_low_coherence
metrics.description: Accuracy at low coherence (5%-10%). Near chance for monkeys (Roitman & Shadlen 2002 Fig 2); ~0.60 for adult humans (Pinet et al. 2024).

metrics.name: accuracy_medium_coherence
metrics.description: Accuracy at 20% coherence. Roitman & Shadlen 2002 monkey psychometric ~0.80; human adult ~0.85.

metrics.name: accuracy_high_coherence
metrics.description: Accuracy at high coherence (40%-80%). Near-ceiling in both monkeys and humans (~0.95-1.00).
